content: The excretion of ethinyl estradiol occurs primarily through the urine in the form of conjugates. Additionally, most estrogens are excreted via bile and undergo enterohepatic recycling. The excretion of norgestimate involves the elimination of 47% through urine and 37% through feces, primarily as metabolites.
